fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on South Florida’s post-boom economic conditions, municipal bond obligations, and local public safety concerns (notably automobile accidents). Reports and opinion pieces address crime and law enforcement, including a coroner’s jury verdict in a Hialeah shooting and discussion of bondsmen and legal technicalities. Local civic news notes the selection of the old Central School site for a new Miami post office. The issue also contains extensive seasonal entertainment and nightlife listings and advertisements (theaters, New Year’s Eve events, clubs), plus sports and racing promotions including greyhound racing and boxing-related items.
